results.title: Brake Pad HS Code 8708.30 — 2.5% US Duty (2026)
results.content:
Brake pads (organic, semi-metallic, ceramic, low-metallic NAO), brake shoes, brake discs (rotors, drilled, slotted, blanked), brake callipers, master cylinders, brake lines (pre-assembled), and drum brakes for motor vehicles are all classified under 8708.30. Major brands: Brembo, Akebono, Bosch, TRW, ATE, Ferodo, EBC, Hawk, StopTech, Wagner, Power Stop. The friction material (ceramic vs metallic vs organic) does not affect classification. Aftermarket performance brake upgrades (Brembo GT, [...] blanks for further machining are 7326 (iron/steel articles). Brake pad friction material (raw mixed into shape but not mounted to backing plate) is 6813.20 (friction material). Chinese-origin brake parts have been subject to Section 301 List 1-3 additional tariffs — verify current US rate. OEM vs aftermarket distinction does not affect HS classification but may affect emissions/safety approval (DOT, ECE R90 for EU). [...] Brake pads and linings sit under HS 8708.30 — aftermarket kits from China may face anti-dumping margins on top of the base MFN rate.
